'''Bursoll II''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose [[Plant/Legends|flora]] included the [[rurylis flower]]. Upon the planet's discovery, the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] wished to use in manufacturing a rare [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Unidentified mineral|mineral]] bountifully present on Bursoll II.

To that end, SoroSuub attempted to appease the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Geben Arrulis]] during his visit to the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. The corporation tasked a group of individuals with bringing rurylis specimens from Bursoll II to Sullust, which it successfully did, although the plant's newly discovered psychoactive effect on [[Species/Legends|beings]] spending [[Time/Legends|time]] with it caused further difficulties with the prince's visit.

==Description==
Bursoll II was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that occupied the second [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="GatORW" /> in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]] [[Bursoll system/Legends|Bursoll system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet had large deposits of a rare [[Unidentified mineral|mineral]] that was [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]]. Bursoll II's [[Plant/Legends|flora]] included the [[rurylis flower]], a plant whose pollen dispersed in the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] but induced a disorienting psychoactive effect in [[Species/Legends|beings]] spending at least a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] in an enclosed space with the plant.<ref name="GatORW" />

==History==
Shortly after Bursoll II's discovery by the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the planet's [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Geben Arrulis]] visited the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. The Sullust-based [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], wishing to utilize Bursoll II's radioactive [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] in manufacturing, attempted to appease the prince so that the corporation would be granted the use of the mineral.<ref name="GatORW" />

{{RPGseed}}
Since Arrulis yearned to see a plant from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in Sullust's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Byllurun|SoroSuub Central]], SoroSuub executives requested that a group of individuals travel to Bursoll II in order to bring a few specimens of the rurylis [[Flower/Legends|flower]] to Sullust. The group successfully retrieved several rurylis plants on Bursoll II but discovered the plant's psychoactive effect&mdash;unknown to almost anyone else&mdash;upon the return journey to Sullust. When the flowers were subsequently planted in a [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] in SoroSuub Central, the rurylis began to affect the local [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], forcing the group to seek a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] way to convince the prince to cooperate with SoroSuub Corporation.<ref name="GatORW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
The [[near-Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Geben Arrulis was a native of Bursoll II and held the title of prince on the planet.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bursoll II was introduced in the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''. The book includes an adventure seed for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', and this article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="GatORW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Bursoll [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Bursoll II, in grid square H-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
